caption:
धनुष और ममूटी की फिल्म ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर कर दिया बड़ा कमाल! 🔥

नवीनतम तमिल फिल्म OM बीस नवंबर को थिएटर्स में रिलीज हुई थी जिसे राजकुमार पेरियासामी ने डायरेक्ट किया है। 🎬
फिल्म लाल चंदन की तस्करी की सच्ची घटनाओं पर आधारित है जिसमें धनुष अंडरकवर पुलिस बने हैं और ममूटी स्मगलिंग रिंग संभाल रहे हैं। 👮‍♂️
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक फिल्म का बजट दो सौ करोड़ रुपये था जो धनुष और ममूटी की सबसे महंगी फिल्म है। 💰
फिल्म की शुरुआती भारत में अठारह दशमलव एक करोड़ नेट रही थी और छह दिनों में भारत में कुल नेट कलेक्शन पैंसठ दशमलव पचानवे करोड़ रुपये हो गया है। 📈
ओवरसीज कलेक्शन छब्बीस दशमलव पचहत्तर करोड़ रुपये रहा जिससे वर्ल्डवाइड टोटल एक सौ चार दशमलव अट्ठावन करोड़ रुपये पहुंच गया है। 🌍
इस फिल्म के सौ करोड़ पार होने से यह धनुष की छठी और ममूटी की करियर की पहली सौ करोड़ी ग्लोबल फिल्म बन गई है। 🌟
क्या आपने यह एक्शन ड्रामा फिल्म देख ली है या नहीं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: OM Worldwide Box Office: Becomes Dhanush’s 6th 100 Crore Grosser, A First For Mammootty
ctx.summary:
Dhanush's latest film, OM, has become his 6th 100 crore grosser globally. It marks the first century for Mammootty.  
 The post  OM Worldwide Box Office: Becomes Dhanush’s 6th 100 Crore Grosser, A First For Mammootty  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The latest Tamil film, OM, has been experiencing a steady decline at the box office since its release. The movie hit theatres on November 20 amid much hype and buzz. The film clashed with Dulquer Salmaan’s Aakasamlo Oka Tara at the box office. It was the first time Mammootty and Dulquer Salmaan had releases on the same day.
The Rajkumar Periasamy-directed film stars Dhanush , Mammootty, and Sai Pallavi in the lead roles. The film is based on real-life incidents of red sandalwood smuggling. The film sees Dhanush playing an undercover cop who infiltrates a smuggling ring handled by Karthikeyan (Mammootty). The Tamil film has now crossed the 100-crore mark at the box office globally.
The film is nearing the end of its opening week at the box office. The Tamil film had a strong opening, bringing in 18.1 crore net in India. However, the film saw a decline at the box office from Day 2. The film received mixed reviews from audiences, which contributed to its decline at the box office.
On its first Wednesday, OM earned 4.1 crore net at the box office. Overall, the film’s net total after 6 days stands at 65.95 crore. This brings the film’s India gross collection to 77.83 crore . Overseas, the film’s total stands at 26.75 crore , bringing its worldwide total to 104.58 crore .
With OM crossing the 100 crore mark globally, it has become Dhanush’s 6th film to enter the club. As for megastar Mammootty , OM marks his very first 100 crore grosser globally. His highest-grossing film previously was the Malayalam film Bheeshma Parvam, which earned 88.5 crore globally.
Take a look at Dhanush’s 100 Crore Grossers Globally:
If reports are to be believed, OM was made on a budget of 200 crore. With such a big budget, it has become Dhanush and Mammootty’s most expensive film ever. The film is centered around wood smuggling, and portions of it are based on true incidents. Sai Pallavi plays a senior police officer tasked with dismantling the smuggling ring led by Mammootty’s character, Siya. Dhanush plays an undercover cop in the film, sent to win Siya’s trust. This is a high-stakes action drama that promises an engaging big-screen experience.
